\[
Y = \frac{w_R R + w_G G + w_B B}{100},
\qquad
(w_R, w_G, w_B) = (30, 59, 11)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(R, G, B\): The encoded channel values from 0 to 255
- \(w_R, w_G, w_B\): The weights in percent

The gray value is a weighted sum of the three channels, with weights in percent. The defaults 30, 59 and 11 are close to the BT.601 luma weights. Weights that add up to 100 keep white white and gray gray. A larger sum brightens the image, a smaller one darkens it. Negative weights darken the areas where that channel is strong.
